closure_rule: MANIFEST.json enumerates every regular file other than itself; verify.py rejects missing, changed, extra or symlinked artifacts. Manifest SHA is retained in the external candidate receipt, avoiding self-hashing.
preservation: Frozen plans, numerical/state/fixture/source/driver/analyzer bytes are original; private pathname-only log/ledger derivatives retain raw hashes and exact replacement counts.
source_snapshot_scope: 37 recorded runtime source files plus compile-time native test fixtures and source-context physics documentation/licences; this is not a complete repository or registry checkout.
historical_scope: Exact retained e342 rest-metadata and full trajectory copied only for historical source-qualified mesh/shared-time comparisons. No historical rerun.
limitations: No full contact/friction force reactions or substep impulse/work accounting
No static equilibrium, convergence, geometric impossibility or solver-defect result
No calibrated fabric/reference parity or general collision proof
No original garment acceptance from capsule omission
independent_review: Kept separately under review-support; its receipt identity and original checker hash remain distinct from producer replay.
publication_gate: Ignored candidate is not public delivery; owner must track all chosen files and run registry/map checks from clean checkout.
